name: parampara-video
description: The three minute submission video, composed with Remotion. Its own pnpm root: the app never installs it (D93).

scripts.render:draft: node scripts/check.ts && remotion render src/index.ts Story out/draft.mp4 --scale=0.5 --crf=30 --props='{"mode":"draft"}'
scripts.render:final: node scripts/check.ts --final && remotion render src/index.ts Story out/parampara.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --props='{"mode":"final"}'
